The '''Tastiged system''' was a part of the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the [[Disease/Legends|disease]] known as [[Tastiged Flu]].<ref name="Wraith">''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Tastiged Flu]]|system=Tastiged [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tastiged [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-6.<ref name="TEA" />
